observations: Front-loading LG washing machine, white cabinet.
Panel text reads 'INVERTER DirectDrive 7 kg' with a partial model code visible, appears to read 'F1068QDP2' or similar.
Door is a round viewing window, large diameter typical of a 7-8kg class machine.
Visible rust/corrosion spots at bottom front corners and along the door hinge area.
No power cable, display screen, or running demonstration visible; control dial and buttons appear intact.
'10 Year Warranty' and 'DD Motor' badges visible on the right side of the door bezel.
Sticker reads 'Less Noise / Less Vibration / More Durability' - marketing sticker, not a serial/capacity plate.

claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale

claims.evidence: photo 0 panel clearly reads 7kg, not 8kg; no 8kg marking visible anywhere

claims.claim: Implied working/functional condition (no explicit text claim, but listing for sale as-is)
claims.evidence: no power-on, spin, or drain demonstration shown

risks.risk: Seller's stated capacity (8kg) conflicts with the machine's own label (7kg), raising doubt about which unit is actually being sold or an attempt to misrepresent value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating/serial plate (usually on rear or inside door rim) showing exact model and capacity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower, photo-confirmed 7kg model, with suspicion flag for misrepresentation

risks.risk: Visible rust at base and door hinge could indicate water leakage or frame corrosion affecting drum bearing or door seal longevity.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of rust spots and a photo of the rear panel/base for leakage stains.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically and structurally compromised

risks.risk: No evidence the drum spins, heats, or completes a cycle; motor or PCB fault cannot be ruled out.
risks.proof: Short video of the machine powered on, dial turned, and spin cycle running with water draining.

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket condition and drum interior cleanliness unknown beyond the one static photo.
risks.proof: Photo of door seal fully open and drum interior under light.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming average wear, no premium for 'like new' interior

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rear rating plate showing exact model number and capacity in kg.
Video of the machine powered on and completing a wash/spin cycle.
Close-up photos of the rusted areas at the base and hinge.
Photo of the door seal fully open and drum interior.
response.reason: The seller explicitly claims the unit is 8kg, but the machine's own visible label in photo 0 clearly reads 7kg, a direct contradiction that suggests an attempt to misrepresent capacity for a higher price; combined with unverified working condition and visible rust, this cannot be safely priced as described.
